name: tn-scroll-list
description: 该组件一般用于同时展示多个商品、分类的场景，也可以完成左右滑动的列表
example:
<template>
  <TnScrollList>
    <view class="item-container">
      <view
        v-for="i in 20"
        :key="i"
        class="scroll-item tn-flex-center tn-flex-column"
      >
        <view class="empty tn-grey-light_bg" />
        <view class="title">图鸟UI</view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </TnScrollList>
</template>

<style lang="scss" scoped>
.item-container {
  position: relative;
  width: fit-content;

  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;

  .scroll-item {
    flex-grow: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin: 0rpx 20rpx;

    .empty {
      width: 100rpx;
      height: 100rpx;
      border-radius: 15rpx;
    }

    .title {
      margin-top: 10rpx;
    }
  }
}
</style>
